Class ResourcesBuilder

java.lang.Object
icyllis.modernui.resources.ResourcesBuilder
public class ResourcesBuilder extends Object
This class allows to build an asset pack at runtime. The resources it creates are all under a single namespace.
Since:
3.13

    • newStyle

      public ResourcesBuilder.Style newStyle(@NonNull @StyleRes String name, @Nullable @StyleRes ResourceId parent)
      Adds a style resource, returns the style builder to fill attribute values.

      The final resource id is new ResourceId(getNamespace(), "style", name).

      Parameters:
      name - the style name
      parent - the parent of the style, if any
      Returns:
      the style builder for the style

    • newStyle

      public ResourcesBuilder.Style newStyle(@NonNull @StyleRes ResourceId id, @Nullable @StyleRes ResourceId parent)
      Adds a style resource, returns the style builder to fill attribute values.

      For the resource id, its namespace must be getNamespace(), and its type must be "style".

      Parameters:
      id - the style resource id
      parent - the parent of the style, if any
      Returns:
      the style builder for the style
      See Also:
      • newStyle(String, ResourceId)
